answer: Each identity posts 70 credits to a garden registry and publishes a one-epoch cipher key. Renewal needs a cipher rotation receipt countersigned by a yarrow auditor, who stakes 20 credits and signs at most 3 renewals per epoch. Reused cipher fingerprints are rejected and both bonds burn. A new auditor costs 30 onboarding plus a 12 fee, so a cap-crossing fake pays 112 credits and others pay 82. 1,000 fakes total 92,020 credits. Honest identities pay 82. A rented-auditor ring fails: a fourth signature is rejected, the stake burns, and copied receipts fail the garden fingerprint check.
